advisory_findings.title: Weekly motion is an endpoint-based estimate
advisory_findings.message: Tooth regions and endpoint matches are automatic drafts. Intervening weeks use uniform translation and rotation interpolation, not observed weekly positions. Review the boundaries, numbering, alignment, and endpoint fit before interpreting changes.
